Docs.summary: Provides the visibility of the drawer (flyout) toggle affordance for an , commonly rendered as a "hamburger" button in the toolbar's navigation slot.

remarks.para: This is a separate optional interface to preserve compatibility for existing implementations, including netstandard2.0 targets where adding the member to the existing interface would require implementers to add it.
Consume it by pattern matching on an : if (toolbar is IToolbarDrawerToggleVisible { DrawerToggleVisible: true }). A toolbar that does not implement this interface has no drawer toggle.

Docs.summary: Gets a value that indicates whether the drawer (flyout) toggle affordance should be displayed in the navigation slot of the toolbar.

remarks.para: The value is computed and owned by the cross-platform layer (for example Shell, or a NavigationPage hosted inside a FlyoutPage) from the current flyout behavior and navigation stack, which is why this contract is read-only. Platform backends should render it, not compute or overwrite it.

This property and are not mutually exclusive: on Windows both can be at the same time. They share a single navigation slot and takes precedence when rendering, so a backend should check the back button first and only fall through to the drawer toggle.
Changes raise a handler update keyed on "DrawerToggleVisible", so a backend maps it like any other toolbar property.
